verdict.rationale: NVIDIA Isaac is a robotics development and deployment platform, so fleet monitoring and alerting is a fair axis to ask about. The evidence covers simulation, synthetic data, robot learning, and accelerated ROS 2 packages, but nothing about alerting on robot faults, battery levels, or connectivity. The phrase "Batteries-included" refers to bundled robot assets, not battery monitoring.

support.subject: As an ops lead, I can get alerts on robot faults, battery, and connectivity so issues are caught before customers notice
